submittedParameters.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. EDIT ONLY knee, ankle and boot alignment in image1, a single frame of this same mountain guardian boy running NORTHEAST AWAY from camera, back three-quarter view. Preserve its complete upper body, camera direction, proportions, hip location, same staff anatomical right hand SCREEN RIGHT, shield anatomical left arm SCREEN LEFT, costume, rendering, and transparent background. Inputs2 identity,3 committed NE idle direction,4 approved polished Q-style,5 neighboring run phase for consistent leg axis. Correct sideways hip/knee rotation rather than replacing the pose. Legs run in two close parallel fore-aft lanes pointing NORTH-EAST, never side-kick wide, frog kick or roll ankles. Bent knee, ankle center and length of the boot follow one coherent forward/back trajectory. Keep BOTH legs and both complete boots visible, with natural knee bend. No duplicated limbs, sole pasted sideways, extra feet, cropping, shadow or background; real transparent alpha. Preserve this individual frame's action, hand/weapon pose and body phase, not identical to neighbor.Frame10. Anatomical LEFT leg SCREEN LEFT remains planted. Anatomical RIGHT leg SCREEN RIGHT is raised behind the body. Reduce right leg's sideways-flared knee and twisted ankle, bringing raised right boot back into its own fore-aft running lane, below/behind right knee. Preserve natural bent knee and visible outsole on swing foot, but no huge laterally presented boot. Reference5 frame11 shows coherent leg line; preserve distinct higher lift of frame10. Support left foot unchanged.
